theorem_title: Uniform coefficient margin for two burst lengths
natural_language_statement:
For every $j,l\in\mathbb N$,

$$
3\cdot9^{j+l+1}+3\cdot9^l+10\cdot8^l2^{j+l+1}<4\cdot16^{j+l+1}.
$$

This numerical inequality supplies slack for the guarded original-root comparison.
formal_statement:
theorem CollatzWork.twoBurst_power_margin (j l : Nat) :
    3 * 9 ^ (j + l + 1) + 3 * 9 ^ l +
        10 * 8 ^ l * 2 ^ (j + l + 1) < 4 * 16 ^ (j + l + 1) := by sorry
